description: Looking for someone who can write a script to scrape all 3000+ US Counties on Redfin on a weekly basis to see active listings vs sold listings (1 month, 3 month, 6 month, 1 year time frames)I use Redfin extensively. The process I use to analyze demand in a market is the following:I choose a county in a state, say cullman county, AL. I then filter for listings 5 acres or more. I then see how many listings are currently available for sale and take note of that number - can call it (Total Active Sales Listing). Then I filter the view to show "Last 1 Month Sold", taking note of that (1 month Sold). Then I filter to "Last 3 Months Sold" (3 months sold). Then filter to "Last 6 Months Sold" (6 months sold). Then "Last 1 Year Sold" ( 1 year sold). I then take each value and divide by the (Total Active Sales) to find the Sell Through Rate for each time period so for instance - the 1 Month Sell Through Rate = (1 month Sold) / (Total Active Sales Listings). I would like to be able to pull this rate each week for all 3000+ counties in the US so that I can gauge demand.
